ug.nonAdmin: Only administrators can add people or change roles. Ask an administrator for help.
ug.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the list of people. Try again.
ug.mode.linuxHint: Everyone here is a real Linux user. Administrators are in the sudo/wheel group; changes run useradd, usermod and chpasswd on the host.
ug.mode.appHint: NoCapOS is running in Docker or on Windows, so it keeps its own accounts. On a native Linux install these are the machine’s Linux users.
ug.role.admin.hintLinux: Full control of NoCapOS, and sudo on this machine
ug.role.user.hint: Uses apps and files; can’t change system settings
ug.role.guest.hint: File sharing only (SMB / WebDAV); can’t sign in to the desktop
ug.empty.noMatchBody: Try a different search or clear the filters.
ug.empty.aloneBody: Give family members or colleagues their own account.
ug.empty.groupsBody: Groups help you organize people, such as Family, Work or Guests. Create one and choose its members.
ug.add.title: Add a person
ug.add.sub: They sign in with this user name and password.
ug.add.subLinux: Creates a Linux account with a home folder and a bash shell.
ug.add.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Longer passwords with mixed characters are stronger.
ug.add.groupsHint: Optional. Select the groups they belong to.
ug.f.usernameHintLinux: Lowercase; used to sign in to NoCapOS and to Linux
ug.v.nameLinux: Use lowercase letters, digits, - or _, starting with a letter.
ug.v.nameTaken: That user name is already taken.
ug.v.groupTaken: A group with that name already exists.
ug.pw.note: Resetting the password signs them out on every device.
ug.pw.signedOut: They have been signed out on all devices.
ug.edit.roleHint: Changing the role takes effect immediately and may sign them out.
ug.edit.selfLocked: You can’t change your own role. Ask another administrator.
ug.edit.spacesAdmin: Administrators can access every shared folder and app.
ug.edit.twofaOn: An authenticator code is required to sign in.
ug.edit.twofaOff: Not set up. They can turn it on in their Security settings.
ug.edit.passwordHint: Set a new password and sign them out everywhere
ug.groups.noneYet: No groups yet. Create one in the Groups tab.
ug.g.sub: Name the group, choose a color and add members.
ug.g.name: Name
ug.g.membersHint: Click a person to add or remove them, or drag them between the lists.
ug.g.dropHere: No members. Click or drop people here.
ug.confirm.disableBody: They are signed out immediately and can’t sign in until the account is enabled again. Their files are kept.
ug.confirm.deleteLinux: This deletes the Linux account “{name}” from this machine and signs them out of NoCapOS.
ug.confirm.deleteApp: This deletes “{name}”. They can no longer sign in, and their chats and settings in NoCapOS are removed.
ug.confirm.homeBody: Their home folder and all files in it are permanently erased. Choose Keep files to leave {home} on disk.
ug.confirm.groupBody: Only the group is removed. Its members keep their accounts and files.
ug.toast.addedLinux: Their Linux account and home folder are ready.
ug.toast.role.guest: {name} is now a guest (file sharing only)
ug.sp.loadFailed: Couldn’t load shared folders and apps
ug.sp.noFolders: No shared folders yet (Files → File Sharing).
ug.sp.noApps: No App Store apps are installed.
ug.sp.adminAll: Administrators can always access every shared folder
